# Vendored browser libraries

- marked 18.0.13: `marked/lib/marked.umd.js` from npm (stored as marked.min.js); MIT, see marked-LICENSE.
- DOMPurify 3.4.15: `dompurify/dist/purify.min.js` from npm; Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0, see accompanying licenses.
- Inline document-tab icons adapt Lucide's book-open, shield and network icons; ISC license: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/blob/main/LICENSE

No CDN requests are made at runtime. The app itself has no third-party dependencies.
